title: Covers Many Holidays
text: Covers Many Holidays. I ordered this door decoration for my elderly father. He lives in an assisted living facility and I wanted to something on his door that was welcoming. Since this covers many different holidays, it's the only door decoration he needs. The removable pieces say in place with magnets. So far the magnets seem to be strong enough. The items are colorful and look good. It definitely has a factory made look to it rather than something hand painted. It is a nice addition to my father's door.

product_metadata.title: INGRINC 15 Pcs Seasonal Interchangeable Welcome Sign For Front Door Decor, Super Cute Welcome Door Sign Set Can Be Used As Fridge Magnet ︱Wooden Front Door Sign For Farmhouse Porch, Office & Wedding
features: 🏠 【Save Big Money With Small Money】 The interchangeable welcome sign for front door decor is designed with irregular graphics. The three-dimensional truck on the welcome door sign is matched with magnetic patches with festive characteristics, adding more festive atmosphere to your house! At the same time, the magnetic patches on this front door sign can be interchanged with the change of seasons or festivals! So you don't have to waste money buying different holiday front door signs!

🏠 【Decorative Fridge Magnet Set】 The 14 super cute magnetic patches that come with the product can be attached not only to the door sign, but also to any metal or magnetic surface when not in use, such as refrigerators, air conditioners, washing machines, and blackboards. This way you don't have to worry about not being able to find them or leaving them idle due to long periods of inactivity! Super cute patterns can also be used to decorate your home!

🏠 【Processing Details Reflect Product Quality】 The door decorations hanging outdoor uses environmentally friendly super glue to bond the three-dimensional truck patch! Using embedded processing technology to embed the magnet inside the porch decorations outdoor and the patch, so that they can be seamlessly attached, and also fundamentally solve the problem of magnet falling off! Premium wood edges are carbonized for corrosion resistant and more durable!

🏠 【Applicable Scenes & Festivals】 This available all year welcome sign is perfect for hanging on front doors, porches, farmhouse porches, offices, wedding receptions, and more. Can also be hung on the wall as a decoration to decorate your home! This festive door sign is perfect for Independence Day, Thanksgiving, Halloween, Christmas, Valentine's Day, Easter, Payday, New Home Move-In, Graduation Party, Church and more. It can also be given as gift to a relative/friend who is moving to new home.

🏠 【Festive Door Sign Set Includes】 Welcome door sign contains 1 door sign, 14 strong magnets, a total of 15 pieces. The size of the product is: 12.79 inches*7.48 inches*0.19 inches (Please allow a deviation of about 0.5cm).
